kpis.name: Order Count
kpis.description: Distinct generated orders, including orders without a review, return or support interaction.

kpis.name: Gross Sales Amount
kpis.description: Extended line amount using the generated post-discount NetPrice multiplied by Quantity; the historical truth-manifest name is retained for compatibility.

kpis.name: On-time Delivery Rate
kpis.description: Share of valid shipments delivered on or before the promised timestamp.
kpis.expression: sum(case when is_on_time then 1 else 0 end) / count(*)

kpis.name: Return Rate
kpis.description: Return requests divided by generated orders.

kpis.name: Average Review Rating
kpis.description: Mean rating over valid Silver reviews only; the injected out-of-range review is quarantined.
